transition.intent: Use the local completion checker before treating the CLI starter as complete or maintenance-only.
transition.validation_command: cmake -S . -B build -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCLI_STARTER_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
transition.decision_rule: Do not infer completion from prose. The referenced completion checker must exist and pass.

phase_model.purpose: Align the automation prompt with real repository validation by creating or replacing the missing completion check.
blocked_work: renaming the starter without explicit scope
exit_criteria: automation prompt no longer points at a missing command

phase_model.purpose: Maintain the CLI starter after completion criteria are machine-checkable.
blocked_work: broad new CLI feature work without explicit task
exit_criteria: a new starter feature scope is explicitly selected

required_gates.description: The local automation prompt requires tests/check_project_completion.py, and the transition command now validates that checker and its covered evidence.
required_gates.on_failure: Create a dependency-free completion checker or update the prompt and phase gate together.

required_gates.description: The C++ starter must configure, build, and pass CTest.
README and command reference should match actual starter behavior after completion checker repair.
Automation must not publish binaries or push unless explicitly requested.
